video_title: It’s quite simple… He’s a star. #atlantahawks #nba #basketballplayer #basketball #podcast

quotes.speaker: Trae Young
quotes.summary_phrase: Trae Young predicts Jalen Johnson will be a perennial All-Star
quotes.quote: Jalen. Yeah, that boy's a star. But don't act like I didn't warn y'all, man. He's so talented. He can rebound and push it like a guard and then play above the rim like a big. His ability to be better at shooting this year, it's like he should have won Most Improved Player if he had played enough games. But he's a hell of a player. Jalen Johnson is about to make his first All-Star appearance. Don't act like I didn't try to warn y'all. This dude has so much game, man. He has so much game that I don't even think he really understands the potential he has yet. If he's out there, this dude is a perennial All-Star, a guy who's going to make multiple All-NBAs, I feel like, if the team success is there. The future is so bright for this kid, man. I'm just so happy that I've been able to be a part of it from the beginning to now, and we'll see what the future brings. But this kid is obviously, Jalen Johnson's a star, bro.
